source.rule: A bridge slot can be a system, item, materiel position, or another reliability block. A series block requires all of its constituent blocks.

configuration.parent: Accepted G07.var03 bridge UL=E, LL=A, BR=B, UR=C, LR=D; B/A OPHOURS failures; five installed LRUs, direct half-hour CM, h8–34 G04-OPS mission, seed1, one replication, horizon36.
configuration.nested: Replace bridge BRBID POS-B with RBDSeries G07-BR-SERIES of POS-B and new healthy POS-F, each in G04-OPS. Install a sixth identical LRU at POS-F under the same system; do not add an F failure mode. The other four bridge slots, B/A failure rates, repairs, mission and seed stay fixed.

pre_run_hypotheses: Native import/export preserves all populated tables including both nested RBDSeriesStructure rows and calculates with zero errors or unreviewed diagnostics.

B failure renders the nested BR series nonfunctional while both direct bridge paths remain; A later failure leaves UL+UR. Any B/A failures during the mission are noncritical and the mission succeeds h34. Exact seeded timing/order is empirical rather than assumed matched.
Reports reconcile failure/repair and terminal ready state. Native logs may report system criticality but not name the nested RBD path or individual series state.
native_acceptance: Unique guarded session-0 SSH run with host-wide mutex, GUI PID13340 identity, registry restoration, frozen source and raw SHA-256 seals.
Exact populated-table import/export roundtrip, zero converter errors, reviewed warnings, nonempty SXO/event log/report.
Observed B/A event identities/criticality and mission/report reconciliation, with independent read-only replay.
diagnostic_gate: Preserve rejected or unmatched runs as diagnostic and revise under new version/run IDs; do not claim nested state is directly logged if the event log lacks a path label.
limits: One two-position series nested in BR, one healthy added position without a failure mode, one mission/seed/replication; other nested types and failure combinations remain unverified.
Nested block state and active path are source-bound inferences unless native output exposes them. No GUI drawing, online maintenance, population reliability or cross-engine claim.
